remarks:
Bring Your Vision to Life! Opportunity awaits at 5 Second Avenue in the Village of Franklinville. Offering 1,832 square feet of living space, this two story home features four bedrooms, two full bathrooms, and provides a head start on your renovation project. Most of the demolition work has already been completed, with both the first and second floors gutted, allowing you to focus on designing and finishing the interior to your style.

The first floor is laid out with a kitchen, living room, laundry area, and a full bathroom. Upstairs you'll find four bedrooms, including one spacious bedroom, along with a large full bathroom featuring a tiled shower and a new vanity.

Many major improvements have already been completed, including new wiring throughout, a 200 amp circuit breaker panel, hardwired smoke and carbon monoxide detectors, ceiling lighting, PEX and copper plumbing, some thermopane windows, and a forced air natural gas furnace. Existing wood floors offer the potential to be restored and incorporated into the finished design.

The exterior features an asphalt shingle roof, asbestos siding, and a partially fenced backyard. To help move your project forward, the sale includes building materials such as drywall, cabinets, vanities, flooring, and an electric stove.

Conveniently located within the Village of Franklinville with easy access to local shops, restaurants, parks, and NYS Route 16. Whether you're looking for your next renovation project, investment opportunity, or a home to finish to your own taste, this property offers plenty of potential. The property is being sold as is.
